title: Late Fees Allowed on Review and the Review Reversal — Apartment Home Lease Collections Standard
content:
This standard fixes, for the most recent late billing period of an Apartment Home Lease, the late fees the review allows and the late fee review reversal.

## §1 Clock and grace

1.1 The late fee review clock starts on the period's due date (the charge date of the period's base rent line).

1.2 The review grace days are the longer of the floor plan's grace period and the minimum late days of the community's state: 5 in Washington, 7 in Colorado, 2 in Texas, none in any other state.

1.3 The first late day of the review is the day after the last review grace day, the review grace days being counted as calendar days after the day the late fee review clock starts.

## §2 Allowed late fees

2.1 The allowed initial late fee is the greater of the floor plan's flat initial late fee component and the review percentage times the period's base rent line, rounded half up to the cent, and it is allowed only when the accrual end falls on or after the first late day of the review. The review percentage is the floor plan's initial late fee percentage.

2.2 The allowed daily late fee lines are the calendar days after the first late day of the review through the accrual end, never fewer than zero and never more than the floor plan's maximum daily late fees. The accrual end is the handling date.

2.3 The allowed daily late fee is the floor plan's daily late fee.

2.4 The review allows the allowed initial late fee plus the allowed daily late fee lines times the allowed daily late fee, rounded half up to the cent and capped at the period cap.

2.5 The period cap is the floor plan's company cap percentage times the period's base rent line; in Texas it is the lower of that and 0.10 (10 percent) times the base rent line, and in Colorado the lower of that and the greater of $50.00 and 0.05 (5 percent) times the base rent line. Each figure is taken to the cent.

## §3 The reversal

The late fee review reversal is the late fees posted for the reviewed period (its late fee lines) less the late fees the review allows, never below zero.

## §4 Worked example (hypothetical)

Base rent line $2,000.00; floor plan grace period 3 days, flat initial component $100.00, initial percentage 5 percent, daily late fee $12.00, maximum 10 daily lines, company cap 12 percent. Due date Thursday 1 May; handling date 12 May.

| Community state | Review grace days | First late day | Allowed daily lines | Initial allowed | Review total before cap | Period cap | Late fees allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Arizona | 3 | 5 May | 7 (6 through 12 May) | $100.00 | $184.00 | $240.00 | $184.00 |
| Texas | 3 | 5 May | 7 | $100.00 | $184.00 | the lower of $240.00 and $200.00: $200.00 | $184.00 |
| Colorado | 7 | 9 May | 3 (10 through 12 May) | $100.00 | $136.00 | the lower of $240.00 and the greater of $50.00 and $100.00: $100.00 | $100.00 |

If the Arizona period's posted late fee lines total $196.00, the reversal is $196.00 less $184.00, that is **$12.00**. If the Colorado period's posted lines total $196.00, the reversal is **$96.00**. If posted lines total less than the amount allowed, the reversal is $0.00.

**Accrual end before the first late day (hypothetical).** With a first late day of 5 May and an accrual end of 4 May, no initial late fee and no daily line is allowed; everything posted is reversed.
